#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
cd /home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listitemid-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin || exit 1
task_fixture=tests/fixtures/vfp9-listitemid-numeric
task_raw=build/listitemid-native
task_build=build/listitemid-gcc
export TMPDIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listitemid-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/build/listitemid-smoke-tmp
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
chmod 700 "$TMPDIR"
export COPPERFIN_LOCALE_DIR=/home/rich/.codex/worktrees/listitemid-numeric-5611/Project-Copperfin/resources/locales
unset ASAN_OPTIONS UBSAN_OPTIONS
task_libraries=()
for task_library in cf_xbase_runtime cf_design_model cf_prg_analysis cf_runtime_text cf_vfp_assets cf_platform_profile cf_security cf_localization cf_platform_support; do
 task_libraries+=("$task_build/lib$task_library.a")
done
for task_phase in before after; do
 if test "$task_phase" = before; then
  task_source="$task_fixture/fixed-attempt1/list-controls-02.before.cpp.txt"
 else
  task_source=tests/test_prg_engine_runtime_surface_functions_list_controls_02.cpp
 fi
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 g++ -std=c++20 -O0 -g0 -Iinclude -Itests -Isrc/runtime -x c++ "$task_fixture/smoke-diagnostic.cpp.txt" "$task_source" -x none "$task_build/tests/CMakeFiles/cf_prg_engine_test_support.dir/prg_engine_test_support.cpp.o" "${task_libraries[@]}" -o "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase" > "$task_raw/compile-smoke-$task_phase.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/compile-smoke-$task_phase.status"
 test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit "$task_status"
 nice -n 10 ionice -c 2 -n 7 "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase" > "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.log" 2>&1
 task_status=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$task_status" > "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.status"
 sha256sum "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.log" > "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.log.sha256"
 if test "$task_phase" = before; then
  test "$task_status" -eq 1 || exit 4
  grep -q 'completed; failures: 2' "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.log" || exit 5
 else
  test "$task_status" -eq 0 || exit 6
  grep -q 'completed; failures: 0' "$task_raw/smoke-$task_phase.log" || exit 7
 fi
done
